CustomField.description: What the buyer types into the order form, for example RUSSELLMOORE. Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only - the order form strips anything else before it looks the code up, so a code containing a space or punctuation can never be redeemed. Matching ignores case.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The code the buyer types, e.g. RUSSELLMOORE. Letters, numbers, - and _ only. Case does not matter.
CustomField.label: Code
